_comment: 3D non-premixed hydrogen burner: a coaxial injector discharging into a
confinement chamber. Central fuel bore, annular air stream, backplane
wall out to the chamber wall.
Dimensions are representative of a laboratory coaxial hydrogen
injector -- 6 mm fuel bore, 20 mm air annulus, 100 mm confinement --
of the kind the HYLON rig is. They are stated assumptions, not
About 40 000 cells, as all four cases of this set are: the GPU this
is benchmarked on carries of order 10 000 threads at once, so a
smaller mesh would leave most of a batch idle and time the launch

segments._comment: confinement chamber; z = 0 is the injector exit plane
